description: No secure disposal procedures in place for equipment, media, or documents containing sensitive information to prevent unauthorized disclosure.
applicability: This signal applies to: Storage media (hard drives, SSDs, tapes) Paper documents and printouts Decommissioned equipment Backup media and archives Mobile devices and removable media

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Review disposal procedures for equipment and media including data sanitization methods, certificate of destruction requirements, and approved disposal vendors. Verify that procedures address different types of media and equipment, specify appropriate sanitization techniques (physical destruction, cryptographic erasure, overwriting), and include documentation requirements. Check for controls ensuring that disposal activities are performed by authorized personnel or vendors and that disposal is properly logged and verified.
